long_biography.plain_text:
Ann Walton Kroenke trained as a registered nurse before inheriting part of her father Bud Walton’s Walmart stake after his death in 1995. Bud had helped his brother Sam turn a single Arkansas discount store into a national retailer. Ann did not follow them into management and has held no executive or board position at Walmart.

Her public business identity later acquired a separate sports dimension when ownership interests in the Denver Nuggets and Colorado Avalanche were transferred to her. Those teams originated in Stanley Kroenke’s independently built real-estate and sports portfolio, and their day-to-day direction sits within the Kroenke family organization. Walmart shares, not her husband’s companies, remain the foundation of Ann’s personal fortune.
